attempted_contrary_interfaces: First-tier diversity treated as independent lower-tier supply.
A complete document treated as operational capability.
A partial exposure or criterion input rejected for failing the whole receiver.
Capacity, stock or staff double-counted for routine and contingency use.
Buyer savings treated as joint fair gain.

positive_controls.argument: A versioned two-sided contract and compatibility checks specify the signal representation and change notification needed to preserve demand meaning.
The commitment horizon and option-expiry date identify how fresh and forward-looking the signal must be to inform that decision.
Forecast assumptions, ranges and separation of targets from commitments specify the demand interpretation and long-lead complement required.
Supplier lead time, item/configuration identity and authorized commitment define the signal scope, forecast horizon and exception path.
The intended operating scenario, support requirement and startup authority specify which demand signal and freshness matter.
The recovery time and state/dependency requirements specify which signal needs to arrive before a useful decision and which exceptions require escalation.
Fleet/configuration and support-end obligations identify the relevant item identities, forecast horizon and retirement exceptions for the signal contract.
The actual consequence, commitment deadline and permitted authority define what signal quality is decision-relevant and when a cheap confirmed request suffices.
